title: Road traffic counts (hourly)
summary: Hourly vehicle counts per road counter (counter_id, hour start in local time, vehicles) from road counters near the monitoring stations, owned by the Mobility Office. Catalog reports about 15 million rows, coverage from 2021-01-01 with no end date, and hourly refresh (last refreshed 2026-10-12). The counter-to-station mapping and direction handling are not documented; a 2024-03-18 counter replacement changed the count basis from per-direction to both-directions combined, so pre- and post-change counts are not directly comparable.

schema.notes: Catalog lists three columns only. No station, road segment, direction or coordinate fields. Direction semantics change on 2024-03-18 per wiki (not reflected in the schema).

spatial.code_system: free-text/opaque counter_id codes; no mapping to stations or coordinates
spatial.notes: Catalog describes counters as 'near the monitoring stations' but gives no location, station mapping or distance. Country inferred from the use case (Valdena, northern Italy, fictional); not stated in the catalog entry.

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: Catalog classification 'internal' (internal.traffic.hourly_counts get_catalog_entry); no separate licence statement found.

access.request_process: Request to the Mobility Office (catalog access.request_process)

documentation_excerpts: Wiki counter_replacement_2024 (owner Mobility Office, last_edited 2024-04-02): 'On 2024-03-18 the road counters were replaced.'
Wiki counter_replacement_2024: 'Before that date, counts were recorded per direction. From 2024-03-18, counts are both directions combined.'
Wiki counter_replacement_2024: 'Do not compare counts across the change without adjusting for it. The catalog entry for traffic.hourly_counts has no note about this.'
Catalog columns ts_local: 'Hour start, local time'; vehicles: 'Vehicles counted in the hour'.
quality_notes: Counter replacement on 2024-03-18 (inside the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) changed count basis from per-direction to both directions combined. Source: wiki counter_replacement_2024 (last_edited 2024-04-02). Catalog entry has no note (catalog export 2026-10-14). Counts before and after are not directly comparable without adjustment.
Catalog and wiki are consistent on the change date and the owner; the catalog is silent on the change, so the wiki is the only documentation of it.
ts_local is stored as local time with no timezone stated; air-quality feeds in UTC require DST-aware conversion for hourly joins (catalog column description; timezone handling not documented).
No documented mapping from counter_id to monitoring station, road segment or distance; N2 'near the monitoring stations' criterion cannot be verified from the catalog.
Missing hours, outages and zero-count semantics (zero vs. no record) are not documented.
Row count is approximate (15,000,000) and not broken down by counter or year.
No sample was taken: the source is a warehouse table reachable only through the Mobility Office request process, so value-level checks (sentinels, negatives, gaps) are unverified.

provenance.claim: Source is owned by Mobility Office, steward Luca Ferri, status active, classification internal, contains_pii false
Coverage starts 2021-01-01 with no end date; refresh cadence hourly; last refreshed 2026-10-12; approx 15,000,000 rows
Counters were replaced 2024-03-18; counts changed from per-direction to both directions combined; catalog has no note on this
Access is via warehouse_sql on request to the Mobility Office; location azure://valdena-health/mobility/traffic_hourly
ts_local is hour start in local time; vehicles is an integer count; counter_id is a string code
